t: An LED wall receiver card that hobbyists reuse as a cheap ECP5 FPGA board.
steps: Buy the i9 v7.2 module bundled with the Muse Lab extension board. AliExpress is the main source. Check the listing says i9 and avoid the different i9plus card.
Install the free Yosys, Project Trellis, nextpnr, and openFPGALoader tools.
Plug the module into the extension board. Connect the board's USB port to your computer.
Build the blink example from the getting started guide in the wuxx Colorlight repo.
Load the design into the FPGA with openFPGALoader. The programmer shows up as a USB drive, but dragging files onto it does nothing.
Run the command ecpdap flash unprotect before writing to flash. The flash ships write-protected.
Write your design to flash. Then try the LiteX target for the i9 to build a RISC-V computer.
